name: std::ranges::zip_view<Views...>::size

declarations.code:
constexpr auto size() const

    requires(ranges::sized_range<const Views> && ...);

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The number of elements, which is the minimum size among all sizes of adapted views.

summary: Returns the number of elements in the zip_view. Provided only if each underlying (adapted) range satisfies sized_range.
